snippet.title: Dead by Daylight | Roots of Dread | Spotlight Trailer
snippet.description:
A long-concealed darkness has manifested. To survive is to face fathomless horror. 

Dead by Daylight’s Roots of Dread Chapter introduces a new Killer, The Dredge, and a new Survivor, Haddie Kaur. A new map, the disquieting Garden of Joy, is also available for all players.

Dead by Daylight: Roots of Dread is available now.

Learn more: https://dbd.game/3kNS58M

Get dolled up for a night on the town with the Malicious Mannequin Collection, featuring a new outfit for Dead by Daylight’s latest Killer, The Dredge. Under certain light, it could almost pass for human.

The Dredge – Twisted Plaything – VERY RARE

Learn more about the Malicious Mannequin Collection here: https://dbd.game/3Mas3YE

Dead by Daylight is a multiplayer action/horror game where one player takes on the role of a brutal Killer and the other four play as Survivors. As a Killer your goal is to sacrifice as many Survivors as possible. As Survivors your goal is to work together to evade, escape, and most importantly – stay alive.      

PLAY DEAD BY DAYLIGHT: https://buythegame.deadbydaylight.com/   

Join the official forum:  https://forum.deadbydaylight.com/en

 Like and follow us on our official Social Media Channels:     
- Facebook:  https://facebook.com/DeadByDaylight
- Twitter:  https://twitter.com/DeadByBHVR
- Instagram:  https://www.instagram.com/deadbydaylight/
